name: Project FashionWorks Summer Classes
description_short: Week-long fashion design workshops (Monday to Friday, 10 to 3) taught by designer and educator Elana Carello at Temple Emanu-El in Providence: a Tween class for ages 8-12 and a Teen class for ages 13-19, covering design vocabulary, sketching fashion figures, markers, color and fabric, mood boards and college portfolio work. All experience levels welcome.

sources.note: Summer Classes collection page: two classes at $425.00, both Sold out

Tween class page: 'Tweens: July 13-17', Monday thru Friday 10-3, Temple Emanu-El, 99 Taft Ave. Providence, RI 02906; Teen class page: 'Teens: July 20-24'. No year given; July 13 and 20 fall on Mondays in 2026
FAQs: participates in the PPAC Summer Camp Arts Scholarship Program for students 11-14; payment plans on request
